_note: 235 keys. ONLY the keys listed in _reviewed have been checked by a native Odia speaker — every other string in this file is an LLM draft awaiting review. Every string here is SPOKEN aloud to a user who cannot read it, so a confidently wrong instruction is worse than an English one. The older rule ('never machine-fill this file') was written when the fallback was believed to be intelligible English. It was not: English text was being pushed through an Odia TTS voice, which is unintelligible in both languages at once. resolve() in i18n/index.js now speaks a fallback in an English voice, so the real comparison is honest Odia drafts against real English — and drafts win, but only for as long as this file keeps admitting what they are. Pipeline: draft -> native speaker review -> move the key into _reviewed. Never promote a key into _reviewed without that review, and never delete this note to make the file look finished.
